title: KALUANDA KIZOMBA FESTIVAL 4° EDITION
description:
✨ KALUANDA KIZOMBA FESTIVAL 2026 ✨
We welcome you to a new edition of Kaluanda Kizomba Festival 2026.
It is our pleasure to officially announce the line-up that will be joining us this year to make you live a unique experience, full of music, connection, and pure Kizomba essence.
Get ready to learn, feel, and dance with artists and DJs who will elevate every moment of the festival 🔥
✨ ARTISTS ✨
💃🏽 Tony & Carla
💃🏽 Stephane & Ana
💃🏽 Seb & Sara
💃🏽 Dino Da Cruz
💃🏽 Jeanette & Maria
💃🏽 Esteban & Sandra
💃🏽 Carlos & Sandra

🎧 DJ’S 🎧
🔥 DJ Linduka
🔥 DJ Kikola
🔥 DJ Akym
🔥 DJ Kazukuta
🔥 DJ Mikelaine
📅 From November 20th to 22nd
📍ALICANTE – SPAIN
🏨 ALL IN ONE – ALANNIA RESORTS GUARDAMAR
When booking your Guardamar cabin, use the code KALUANDA26 to stay on the same street as the organization, creating a stronger community vibe and shared festival experience.
Additionally, subscribe to the Alannia Club through the hotel’s official website and enjoy a 5% discount.
🎟 TICKETS ⬇️

✨ If you feel Kizomba, this is your place.
The energy, the level, and the magic of Kaluanda can’t be explained… they must be lived.
